items.summary: Deliver a single combined frontend polish update covering the remaining pre-launch steps (3, 4, and 5) as one cohesive release, focusing on UX clarity, copy, loading/empty states, and final UI refinements across the main tabs (Home, Insights, Memories, Activities, Us).

Add/standardize user-friendly loading states and empty states for key data-driven surfaces (Insights metrics/cards, ritual history lists, photos/memories lists, pairing/partner info panels, and love-language sync panels) without changing React Query configuration or provider setup.

Polish error handling and recovery UX for failed canister calls (e.g., pairing code check, ritual submission, quiz save/reset, insights fetch) by presenting clear error messages and safe retry actions, without deleting or removing any existing/legacy code paths referenced in the current step 4 plan.

Apply lightweight performance and UI responsiveness tweaks that do not involve React Query setup changes (e.g., reduce unnecessary re-renders in high-traffic components, avoid expensive computations during render, and ensure animations do not degrade scrolling).

Perform a final manual QA pass aligned to the existing checklist and update the checklist only as needed to reflect the combined single-release polish verification steps (without changing app features).
